title: CultureCLIP: Empowering CLIP with Cultural Awareness through Synthetic Images and Contextualized Captions
reasoning: The paper focuses on fine-grained cultural recognition and introduces the CulTwin dataset. Its cultural taxonomy explicitly includes 'Symbol' (covering religious icons) and 'Festival' (covering traditions like Christmas and Diwali). It evaluates models on concepts involving religious figures (e.g., Daoist deities) and religious practices (e.g., praying during Chhath) as part of its benchmarking of 'Cultural Fidelity'.
